title: What is the Best AI App Builder for SaaS Founders in 2026? Global Report
summary: We scored nine AI app builders across 9 SaaS-specific criteria, from multi-tenant auth to agent-ready APIs. Every score checked against vendor docs, plus a real security incident analysis.
body_markdown: Only if the builder exposes a documented API or MCP surface for the product it generates, not just for its own build workflow. Blink exposes 80+ MCP tools covering database, auth, backend, hosting, and its AI gateway, usable from Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or a hosted Claude and ChatGPT connector, so a Blink-built SaaS is agent-callable from day one and the builder itself can be driven by an agent too. Base44 is the one other tool with a real answer here: every published app gets its own MCP server, OAuth-scoped to the signed-in customer. Bolt, Anything, Emergent, and v0 have no documented MCP server for the apps they generate.
